$comment: Copy this file to submissions/<your-slug>.json and fill every field. Keep the prompt exactly as the creator published it. A maintainer pushes the file through goodcase.ai's review; it is deleted from submissions/ once the case is exported into data/ (or rejected, with a reason in the PR).
title: Short descriptive title (English or Chinese)
sourceUrl: https://x.com/<creator>/status/<id>  (the creator's ORIGINAL post; aggregators are rejected)
creator: @handle as shown on the source platform
promptFull: The full prompt text, verbatim from the source post.
mediaUrl: https://... direct link to the output video or poster shown in the source post
notes: Optional: what makes this case worth including, or anything a reviewer should know.
